reviews.comment: I had a fantastic experience with Omniware Tech. Chandima was incredibly meticulous and clearly brings a wealth of experience to the table. He didn't just service my PC, he recommended the exact updates I needed to streamline my workflow and improve performance. His attention to detail was impressive, ensuring everything was set up perfectly for my specific needs. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for expert support! :)

Man, building my first PC was kinda intimidating, but Sinner, the legend behind Omniware made it such a smooth and fun experience. Dude really knows his stuff and took the time to help me pick out the perfect parts instead of just pushing random expensive gear.

What I loved most was how personal the whole thing felt. It wasn’t just some generic service. he actually cared about getting me exactly what I needed. The build turned out sick, runs like a dream, and I honestly couldn’t have asked for a better experience.

If you’re thinking about getting yours built, trust me hit up Omniware. Sinner’s the real deal!

I recently had a fantastic experience at Omniware! From start to finish, their service was incredibly friendly and efficient. The team was welcoming, making sure I felt comfortable and informed throughout the process. I had a custom build in mind, and they exceeded my expectations, completing it to absolute perfection. The staff showed impressive attention to detail and kept me updated every step of the way. It’s clear they are knowledgeable and passionate about what they do, and their expertise shines through in their work. Highly recommend Omniware for anyone looking for quality service and top-notch computer builds!
Upgraded my laptop HDD to a 1TB NVMe. Excellent customer service and quick repair! Needless to say, it was the best experience I’ve ever had.

Omniware is my go-to place for all computer equipment! I recently purchased a headset from them, and I couldn't be happier with my experience.
The staff was incredibly friendly, and their service was reliable and trustworthy. It's clear they prioritize quality and customer satisfaction. If you're looking for a dependable place to buy tech gear, I highly recommend Omniware!

Highly recommend, had a good service and adviced upgrades for my desktop, easy comms, and updates on process.

Took it upon as his own, and understood my requirement.
Thank you Ominware! Sinner GG
Very good service. I initially bought a 4070 off of them, I was planning on installing it myself but got it installed off of them as well! Amazing vendor, its where I go for any PC upgrades nowadays.
Friendly service, clear explanation, fast work. Highly recommended 💯 …

I can't thank Omniware Technologies enough for their excellent service! My laptop suddenly stopped working, leaving me completely stranded and struggling to get my work done. As a university student, being without my laptop and working on critical projects was a nightmare.

That's when Omniware came to save the day. They were professional, quick, and thorough, diagnosed the problem immediately and explained it all in terms I could understand. They went the extra mile to get the repair done as quickly as possible and now my laptop is working like brand new!

Their excellent service has saved me from setbacks and lost important work. I highly recommend Omniware Technologies to everyone for fast, reliable, and expert repairs. They are very customer-oriented, and their results are phenomenal. Thanks again for saving the day!

Ordered a 5700X, and they delivered and installed it before the delivery date as well. They called the next day to check up on my PC and made sure it was all good and asked to call them if I needed any help. Amazing and friendly service, definitely my new go-to shop for PC parts!!

Got my first pc build from here in 2023, as of now I have not come across any problems with my pc. Got some accessories for my setup too. All very fast service as well.
Very very satified with the service!
Friendly and Fast service!. had bought many products from Omniware Technologies, Highly recommended place to get your techy needs!
